faqs.q: What are the Air Systems International Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs used for?
faqs.a: The Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs range covers quick-disconnect plugs (the male, nipple half) with female-threaded and male-threaded ends. It lists 4 part numbers for compressed-air lines, on the Hansen interchange profile, and the mating half must share that interchange profile.

faqs.q: What part numbers does the Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs range include?
faqs.a: The Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs range lists 4 part numbers, such as QDH3PL4F, QDH3PL4M and QDH3PL6F. faqs.q: What sizes do the Air Systems International Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs come in?
faqs.a: The Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs range is listed with its sizes given row by row in the size table across 4 part numbers. faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Air Systems International Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs?
faqs.a: For the Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs range: match the plug to the body size of the coupler it will connect to first, then pick the thread or barb size for your line. Body size and connection size are separate dimensions, so do not choose from the thread size alone. Send the part number you are replacing, or its mating half, and we confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Air Systems International Hansen 3000 Series Quick Coupler Plugs?
